title: Constructive Total Loss — 50% Economic Rule
citation: UAE Unified Motor Vehicle Insurance Policy (CBUAE Standard applied by Sukoon, Orient, ADNIC), Chapter 1, Section 2, Article 7(2)
text: The motor vehicle shall be considered a Constructive Total Loss if the certified estimated cost of repairing the accidental damage exceeds fifty percent (50%) of the insured declared vehicle value agreed upon immediately prior to the collision event. Settlement shall be computed based on the pre-accident agreed value less any applicable policy deductible.
